title: Differential gene expression in intercalated cell type A in chronic kidney disease (KPMP 2021)
bodyHtml:
The plot and table below show differential expression of the listed genes in kidney intercalated cell type A between individuals with and without chronic kidney disease.

The results were downloaded from the Kidney Precision Medicine Project (KPMP):

Rationale and design of the Kidney Precision Medicine Project.
de Boer IH et al.
Kidney Int. 2021 Mar;99(3):498-510. doi: 10.1016/j.kint.2020.08.039.
PMID: 33637194

View results from this study in the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
